Animations.Title: Animations
Animations.DraftHelp: These settings stay in this draft until Save. Preview and Reset affect this editor only.
Animations.KeepActive: Keep effect active while condition matches
Animations.ContinuousHelp: Continuous effects stop when the condition becomes false. One-shot rules run only on matching changes.
Animations.TransitionHelp: Use a duration above zero to enable transitions. Character values are read only; these settings animate their display.
Animations.TriggerHelp: Choose an event, optional condition, and visual action. Layer and whole-widget manual rules appear in Live Controls. To manually animate a component there, add a whole-widget manual rule targeting that component. Character fields come from the active system adapter.
Animations.TriggerLimit: At most 32 trigger rules are supported.
Animations.PreviewFailed: The preview could not be played.
Animations.TestHelp: Editor preview uses this draft. For OBS, save this overlay and select it in Active on stream. Test actions never change real Actor statistics.
Animations.AnimationsDisabled: Overlay animations are disabled. Fade In, Fade Out, Pulse, and carousel transition effects are suppressed; pages and characters still change instantly. Open Foundry Game Settings → Modular Stream Overlay → Enable overlay animations and turn it on to enable animated overlays.
Animations.ReducedMotion: Reduced motion is active in this browser. Fade In, Fade Out, Pulse, and carousel transition effects are suppressed; pages and characters still change instantly. To enable animated overlays, open Foundry Game Settings → Modular Stream Overlay → Respect reduced motion and turn it off. Your operating-system settings stay unchanged.
Animations.Hidden: This widget is hidden. Click Play Entrance Animation before testing another effect.
Animations.LayerHidden: This layer or its parent is hidden. Show it with the layer visibility control before testing animations.
Animations.Detached: This widget is not mounted in the preview. Wait for the preview to load.
Animations.PlaybackBlocked: This widget cannot play an animation in its current state.
Animations.PlaybackStatusUnavailable: Preview playback status is unavailable. Refresh diagnostics after the preview loads.
Animations.ChooseTest: Choose an action to test the selected widget.
Animations.AddTestWidget: Add a character widget to test its animations and carousel.
Animations.ConfigureEntrance: Configure an entrance animation for this widget before testing it.
Animations.ConfigureExit: Configure an exit animation for this widget before testing it.
Animations.TestFailed: The test could not be played.
Animations.OBSDiagnosticsHelp: OBS commands use the saved active overlay. The runtime metadata below belongs to this editor preview.

Template.EmptyWidgetDesigns: Create a widget design to begin.
Template.ImmediateSelectionHelp: Selection broadcasts the saved configuration immediately.
Template.ConflictHelp: Saved settings changed in another session. Your draft is preserved. Reload to use the saved version before editing again.
Template.ChooseLayerImage: Choose a PNG, JPEG, or WebP layer image
Template.DragHelp: Drag to move · Handles resize · Top handle rotates (Shift: 15°) · Shift/Ctrl+click or drag on empty space to select several · Hold Alt for distances and free placement · Drop or paste images
Template.TransparencyHelp: Checkerboard indicates transparency. Canvas changes stay private until you save.
Template.PreviewCharacterHelp: The preview character is temporary. Saving updates the reusable design. Configure each linked instance's character list and combined playback in Carousel Settings.
Template.LayerOrderHelp: Top layer is in front. Double-click a name to rename it. Drag rows to restack layers or move them into or out of a group. The background stays behind all layers.
Template.WholeWidgetHelp: These settings apply to the grouped card and are reused by linked instances. Use the selected layer's properties for individual component effects.
Template.WidgetDimensionsHelp: Local widget design dimensions. Instances scale together inside an overlay.
Template.OBSDimensionsHelp: Match these dimensions in your OBS Browser Source.
Template.ChooseBackground: Choose a PNG, JPEG, or WebP background image
Template.AssetPathPlaceholder: Foundry asset path; blank is transparent
Template.BackgroundHelp: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP, or browse Foundry’s existing images. Changes stay in the preview until you save.
Template.StartWidgetHelp: Add a portrait, name, and supported resource fields, then save this design for any character.
Template.StartOverlayHelp: Create a configuration, choose a background, then add its URL to OBS.
Template.LoadPresetHelp: Loading saves the preset into the selected overlay. Built-in presets can be duplicated.
Template.ViewerHelp: Use a separate account for OBS, not the one you play or run the game with. Any role works: Foundry's permissions for that account decide which characters it can read. An Assistant GM already observes every Actor, so no per-Actor access is needed; a Player or Trusted Player needs Observer access to the Actors your widgets show. The OBS session can do everything its role allows in Foundry, so keep that account's password private. Select it here before connecting OBS.
Template.OBSHelpBefore: In OBS, add a Browser Source with this URL and the canvas dimensions above. If it shows Foundry's sign-in page, use
Template.OBSHelpAfter: to sign in as the selected viewer; Foundry then returns to the overlay by itself. Foundry forgets sign-ins when it restarts. To skip signing in, run the optional OBS connector (tools/obs-connector.bat in the module folder) and use http://localhost:30001/ as the URL instead. Save changes here to update the stream automatically.
Template.LibraryHelp: Design once, then use Add widget in an overlay to assign a different character to each instance. Editing a shared design updates linked instances. Preview values use safe placeholders until a character is selected in the designer.
Template.EmptyLibrary: Create a widget preset to start a reusable character design.
Template.LibraryFieldsHelp: Choose fields from your system's catalog in the designer. CAIN examples use CAT, Stress and other native resources; assign a Character after installation.
Template.LiveHelp: These controls affect the saved live overlay and OBS immediately. Editor drafts stay private.
Template.EmptyLiveLayers: The active overlay has no layers yet.
Template.ChooseLiveOverlay: Select a saved overlay to control its layers.
Template.ExportFileHelp: Save this overlay with the widget designs it uses (or this widget design) as a file, to move it to another world or GM. Images are referenced by path, not included.
Template.ImportFileHelp: Add an exported overlay, widget design or fragment. Nothing is replaced: taken IDs get new ones.

Editor.CanvasNumber: Enter a whole number from 64 to 7680.

Editor.NowTransparent: The stream overlay is now transparent.

Editor.ChooseActorHelp: Choose a character, paste its link, or leave blank to place an unassigned widget. Only characters visible to both the GM and stream viewer are listed.
Editor.NoMatchingActors: No matching permitted Actors. Give the stream viewer Observer access to a character to include it.
Editor.DragActor: Drag an Actor from Foundry's Actor Directory.
Editor.UnlockBeforeDelete: Unlock this layer before deleting it.
Editor.EmptyLayers: Add an image or text layer to start composing.
Editor.CorrectLayer: Correct this layer property before saving.
Editor.SelectLayerHelp: Select a layer on the canvas or in the list to edit its properties. Shift/Ctrl+click or drag a rectangle on empty space to select several.
Editor.EmptyImageHelp: Choose an image to display. The empty frame is visible only in this editor.
Editor.KeyboardHelp: Arrow keys move 1 px; Shift moves 10 px. Hold Alt to see distances to nearby layers and the canvas edges. Ctrl/Cmd+C copies, +X cuts, +V pastes (layers between worlds and browsers, or an image), +D duplicates, +A selects all, +G groups, +Shift+G ungroups, Esc deselects. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes (last 100 steps); Ctrl/Cmd+Y or Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z redoes. Delete removes an unlocked layer.
Editor.InheritMotion: Inherit shared widget animations and triggers
Editor.InheritedMotionHelp: This widget uses the shared design's grouped animations and triggers. Edit the shared design, or turn off inheritance to configure only this instance.
Editor.NoMaximum: This field has no declared numeric maximum. Choose a maximum field manually.
Editor.ResourceDotsHelp: Circles show one unit each for whole-number maxima from 1 to 60. Other maxima use a continuous bar.
Editor.FieldsHelp: Available fields come from the active game system adapter. Missing values use the fallback; unavailable resources have no live fill. Templates accept {character.field} tokens and plain text.
Editor.SourcePresetMissing: The source widget preset is missing. Restore it or choose a new widget.
Editor.DemoHelp: DEMO DATA: synthetic characters and simulated values. No Foundry Actor documents are created or changed. Switch to Foundry Actors to use your characters with this same design.
Editor.NoAssignedCharacter: No character assigned. Drop an Actor here or choose a character.
Editor.AlreadyAssigned: This character is already assigned to the widget.
Editor.ActorUnavailablePreview: This character is not available in the current preview. Check the source and widget design.
Editor.ActorLimit: A widget can have up to 20 assigned characters.
Editor.CorrectCarousel: Correct this carousel setting before saving.
Editor.DwellRange: Enter 0.1–3600 seconds, or leave blank to inherit.
Editor.TransitionRange: Enter 0–10000 milliseconds, or leave blank to inherit.
Editor.InformationMode: Information Only — one character, all pages
Editor.CharacterMode: Character Only — all characters, one page
Editor.CombinedMode: Combined — all pages for each character
Editor.PagesFirst: Pages First — A/1, A/2, B/1, B/2
Editor.CharactersFirst: Characters First — A/1, B/1, A/2, B/2
Editor.AssignedDrop: Assigned Characters — drop Foundry Actors here
Editor.NoCharacters: No characters assigned. Add a character or drop an Actor here.
Editor.SharedCardHelp: This design has a single shared card. Add information pages in the Widget Designer to cycle information.
Editor.PreviewHelp: Preview controls affect this editor only. Save to apply configuration to OBS. Display duration starts after each transition completes. Empty duration and transition fields inherit the shared preset.
Editor.NoPreviewSteps: No available character/page steps. Assign a character and enable an information page.
Editor.WaitUpload: Wait for the background upload to finish.
Editor.OverlayUpdateFailed: The overlay could not be updated.
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.DiscardPrompt: Discard the changes in this preview?

Editor.WaitOperation: Wait for the current overlay operation to finish.
Editor.NoUploadedPath: Foundry did not return an uploaded image path.

Editor.BackgroundUploaded: Background uploaded to the preview. Save overlay to publish it to OBS.
Editor.UploadedLayerChanged: The image was uploaded, but the layer changed. Browse existing to select it.
Editor.ImageUploaded: Image uploaded to the preview. Save overlay to publish it to OBS.
Editor.PresetLoaded: Preset loaded and saved to the selected overlay.
Editor.URLSelected: The URL is selected. Copy it with Ctrl+C.
Editor.SharedDesign: Shared design: {name}. This instance keeps its own character and placement when the design changes.
Editor.ConfiguredSteps: {count} configured sequence steps. Local preview uses current Actor permissions and skips unavailable data where configured.
Editor.StrongAccent: Bold text uses the character accent color
Editor.HideEmptyLines: Hide lines whose fields are empty
Editor.EmptyText: Text when the result is empty
Editor.TextLayoutHelp: With bold markup, **text** is bold within one line. {field|label} shows the value label for that field, e.g. 2=Spirit. Empty lines and the empty text react only to empty values; unavailable values still show the missing-value text.
Editor.StaticMarkupHelp: With bold markup, **text** is bold within one line.
Editor.AccentFill: Fill with the character accent color
Editor.CirclesHelp: Used by the Circles display. A fixed number of circles ignores the maximum field. Size and spacing let circles line up with printed artwork.
Editor.BoxStyleHelp: Leave a field empty to keep the default. Colors are hexadecimal, e.g. #111111 or #00000059 with transparency.
Editor.ProfilesHelp: Values the game system does not store. Each character's profile is shared by every overlay and widget showing that character. Leave the accent empty to use the system's character color (CAIN: the blasphemy color). A full name replaces the name written in parentheses in the Actor name. Without full-body art, the player's avatar is used, then the Actor portrait.
Editor.ProfilesNoCharacters: Assign world characters to this widget first.
Editor.PasteUnsupported: This kind of layer cannot be pasted here: widget designs cannot hold widgets, and overlays cannot hold character components.
Editor.SelectionHelp: Commands, shared properties and alignment apply to every selected layer; locked layers stay where they are. Drag any selected layer to move them together, or the frame's handles to resize or turn them together (Shift keeps proportions or 15° steps). Shift/Ctrl+click adds or removes a layer. Clicking a grouped layer selects its group; click it again to pick just that layer.
Editor.DistributeHorizontal: Distribute horizontally with equal gaps (3+ layers)
Editor.DistributeVertical: Distribute vertically with equal gaps (3+ layers)
Editor.LockedLayersKept: Locked layers were kept. Unlock them to delete them.
Editor.PasteMissingDesign: This widget's design is not in this world. Copy or import the widget design first, then paste the widget again.
Editor.GroupNeedsTwo: Select at least two layers to group them.
Editor.CollapseGroup: Hide the group's layers in this list
Editor.ImagesAdded: Image layers added: {count}. Save to publish them to OBS.
Editor.VersionsHelp: Each save keeps a version in this browser (the last 30). Restoring one puts it in the editor as unsaved changes: save to publish it, or undo to go back.
Editor.NoVersions: No saved versions in this browser yet. They appear after the next save.
Editor.VersionRestored: The version from {date} is in the editor as unsaved changes.
Editor.SaveFragmentHelp: Keep the selected layers (for example a character plate) to insert them into any overlay or widget design
Editor.NoFragments: Save a group or selected layers to insert them anywhere with one click.
Editor.DeleteFragmentPrompt: Delete the fragment {name}? Layers already inserted stay.
Editor.SelectForFragment: Select the layers to save as a fragment first.
Editor.RescaleHelp: Every layer moves and resizes with the canvas; fonts, borders, corners and shadows follow the smaller factor.
Editor.RescaleFit: Fit: keep proportions and center (empty margins if the proportions differ)
Editor.RescaleStretch: Stretch: fill the new canvas in both directions
Editor.ImportDroppedActors: {count} character assignments were left out because those Actors are not in this world. Assign the characters again.
Editor.ExportFragment: Export the fragment to a file
Editor.MaskImage: Mask image (its transparency hides the layer)
Editor.ShapeHelp: The shape, mask and faded edges clip the whole layer, such as a portrait inside a hexagon or a picture fading into the background. Rounded corners are under Box style.

Settings.LanguageHint: Choose the language of this module's configuration interface on this client. Auto follows Foundry; unsupported languages use English. Stream content is unchanged.

animationsEnabled.Name: Enable overlay animations
animationsEnabled.Hint: Disable to finish value transitions immediately and stop temporary visual effects.

respectReducedMotion.Name: Respect reduced motion
respectReducedMotion.Hint: Suppress all overlay effects, including fades, Pulse and carousel transitions, when the output browser requests reduced motion. Turn this off to play your authored overlay animations; Windows and Foundry interface preferences remain unchanged.

debugAnimations.Name: Animation and carousel debug mode
debugAnimations.Hint: Record actual playback, motion blockers, computed styles and interruption reasons; no Actor statistics are logged.
